hook: You've rewritten the same prompt 6 times. The AI still doesn't get it. That's not a you problem.
caption:
You've rewritten the same prompt 6 times. The AI still doesn't get it. That's not a you problem.

Here's what's actually happening:

Every time you start a new chat, the AI meets you for the first time. Again. It doesn't know you think in systems before details. It doesn't know you hate bullet points. It doesn't know you need the counterargument before you'll trust the recommendation.

So you over-explain. You add qualifiers. You type three paragraphs of context just to get one useful paragraph back.

That tax you're paying at the start of every single conversation? That's the gap between how you think and how the AI defaults to responding.

The fix isn't a better prompt. It's a profile.

When the AI already knows you're a big-picture thinker who needs concrete examples to stress-test ideas — you skip the warmup. You get to the actual work.

BootFile builds that profile from a short assessment of how you process information, make decisions, and communicate. One time. Then it travels with you.

Stop re-introducing yourself to a tool you use every day.
